content: Nɑ tii sɔ̃ɔwɑ nɑ nɛɛ, kon nuku dobu kɑsuwɑ. Kon dɑwɑ n dɑburɑ ye n sɑ̃ɑ doo nɔɔru. Adɑmɑ nɑ deemɑ ye kpuro yɑ tubum sɛ̃.
Mɑ nɑ nɛɛ, yɛ̃ɛsu su sɑ̃ɑwɑ ɡɑri bɑkɑru, ɑrufɑɑni yerɑ̀ nuku dobu bu mɑɑ mɔ.
Mɑ nɑ ɡɔ̃ru doke nɑ nɛɛ, kon tɑm nɔwɑ nɡe mɛ ɡɑri bɑkɑsu su rɑ ko. Adɑmɑ ko nɑ n kɑ tii nɛniwɑ. Domi nɑ kĩwɑ n ɡiɑ ye n burɑm bo tɔmbu bu ko ben wɑ̃ɑru sɔɔ.
Nɑ sɔm bɑkɑnu kuɑ. Nɑ diɑ bɑnɑ mɑ nɑ resɛm dɑ̃ɑ ɡbɑɑnu kuɑ.
Nɑ tii kɑrɑ kuɑ kɑ mɑɑ dɑ̃ɑ ɡbɑɑnu. Mɑ nɑ dɑ̃ɑ mɑrum bwese bwesekɑ duurɑ mi.
Nɑ bwii ɡbɑ yìn nim bɑ ko n dɑ dɑ̃ɑ ni yɛ̃ke.
Nɑ yoo tɔn durɔbu kɑ tɔn kurɔbu dwɑ. Mɑ nɑ ben bii be bɑ mɑrɑ yoo te sɔɔ nɛni. Mɛyɑ nɑ mɑɑ kɛtɛ ɡɔ̃su kɑ yɑ̃ɑ ɡɔ̃su mɔ n kere sinɑm be bɑ mɑn ɡbiiye Yerusɑlɛmuɔ.
Nɑ sii ɡeesu kɑ wurɑ ɡurɑ kɑ sere sinɑmbun ɑrumɑni kɑ berɑ kɑ berɑn ɑrumɑni. Mɑ nɑ tii wom kowobu kɑsuɑ tɔn durɔbu kɑ tɔn kurɔbu kɑ sere ye tɔn durɔ u rɑ kɑ̃. Yerɑ kurɔ dɑbinu.
Mɑ nɑ yĩsiru yɑrɑ n kere sinɑm be bɑ mɑn ɡbiiye Yerusɑlɛmuɔ. Kɑ mɛ, nɛn bwisi mɑn wɑ̃ɑsi.
Ye nɛn nɔni yi binɛ kuɑ kpuro kɑ nuku doo bi nɛn ɡɔ̃ru ɡɑ kĩ, nɑ ku rɑ yinɛ. Nɛn sɔmburu kpuro tɑ rɑ mɑn nuku dobu wɛ̃. Nuku doo biyɑ bu kuɑ nɛn ɑre.
Yen biru, nɑ sɔmɑ ye nɑ kuɑ kpuro mɛɛrɑ kɑ wɑhɑlɑ ye nɑ kuɑ ye sɔɔ. Mɑ nɑ deemɑ ye kpuro yɑ tubum sɛ̃. Yɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe wi u kĩ u woo kpɑrɑ. Sɔmɑ ye tɔnu u mɔ̀ u ku rɑ yen ɑrufɑɑni wɑ u di kɑ ɡem.
Mɑ nɑ nɛn lɑɑkɑri wesiɑ n kɑ wɑ ɑrufɑɑni ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ bwisi kɑ ɡɑri bɑkɑru kɑ wiirɑru sɔɔ. Wi u koo nɛ sinɑ boko kɔsire ko, mbɑ u koo ko mɑ n kun mɔ ye yɑ rɑɑ koore kɔ.
Nɑ wɑ bwisi yi ɡɑri bɑkɑru ɑrufɑɑni kere nɡe mɛ yɑm bururɑm mu yɑm wɔ̃kuru ɑrufɑɑni kere.
Bwisiɡii u rɑ n yɛ̃ mi u dɔɔ, ɑdɑmɑ ɡɑri bɔkɔ ɡɑ rɑ n bɑbiwɑ yɑm wɔ̃kuru sɔɔ. Kɑ yen de, nɑ yɛ̃ mɑ ɡɑ̃ɑ teenu nu be kpuro mɑrɑ.
Mɑ nɑ tii sɔ̃ɔwɑ nɑ nɛɛ, nɛ kɑ ɡɑri bɔkɔ, wɑ̃ɑrun kɔkɔrɔ tiɑ bɛsɛ kpuro sɑ mɔ. Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ bwisiɡii. Domi nɑ wɑ mɑ yen tii yɑ tubum sɛ̃.
Bwisiɡiin bwisi kun ɡɑri bɔkɔn ɡɑri bɑkɑru tɛɛbu kerɑmɔ, domi sɑɑ fiiko sɔɔ, bɑ koo be kpuro duɑri. Bwisiɡii u koo ɡbiwɑ nɡe mɛ ɡɑri bɔkɔ u koo ɡbi.
Mɑ nɑ wɑ̃ɑru tusɑ. Domi ye yɑ koorɑmɔ hɑnduniɑ ye sɔɔ, yɑ mɑn bwɛ̃rɑ yɑrɑ yèn sɔ̃ ye kpuro yɑ tubum sɛ̃. Yɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe wi u kĩ u woo kpɑrɑ.
Nɑ sɔmburu tusɑ te nɑ kuɑ hɑnduniɑ ye sɔɔ. Domi kon ten nuku dobu ɡoo deriɑwɑ wi u koo mɑn kɔsire ko.
Wɑrɑ yɛ̃ yɛ̃ro wi, ù n ko n sɑ̃ɑn nɑ bwisiɡii ǹ kun mɛ ɡɑri bɔkɔ. Kɑ mɛ, wiyɑ u koo nɛn sɔmbu ten ɑrufɑɑni di te nɑ kuɑ kɑ bwisi. Nɑ wɑ mɑ ye kpuro yɑ tubum sɛ̃.
Mɑ ye kpuro sɔɔ, nɛn nuki sɑnkirɑ wɑhɑlɑ ye nɑ kuɑn sɔ̃.
Wee tɔnu u rɑ sɔmburu ko kɑ bwisi kɑ yɛ̃ru kpɑ tu nùn ɑre mɑruɑ. Adɑmɑ sɔ̃ɔ teeru u rɑ tu ɡoo deriewɑ wi u kun ɡɑ̃ɑnu kue te sɔɔ. Annɑ ɑ kɔ̃sɑ wɑ mi! Yɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ ye yɑ tubum sɛ̃.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, ɑrufɑɑni yerɑ̀ tɔnu u mɔ win sɔmbu te u tii kuɑmmɛ sɔɔ hɑnduniɑ mini.
Domi ye u mɔ̀ win wɑ̃ɑru sɔɔ kpuro wɑhɑlɑ kɑ bwisikunɑ yɑ rɑ kɑ nùn nɑɑwɛ. Bɑɑ kɑ wɔ̃kurɔ, win lɑɑkɑri ku rɑ n kpĩ. Yenibɑ kpuro yɑ tubum sɛ̃.
Gɑ̃ɑnu ɡɑnu sɑri ni nu wɑ̃ mɑ n kun mɔ tɔnu u di u nɔ, kpɑ u nuku dobu ko win sɔmɑn ɑren sɔ̃. Adɑmɑ nɑ wɑ mɑ ye kpuro yɑ weewɑ Gusunɔn min di.
Goo sɑri wi u koo di u nuku dobu ko win sɔmburun sɔ̃ mɑ n kun mɔ kɑ Gusunɔn yɛ̃ru.
Domi wi u nùn wɛ̃rewɑ u rɑ bwisi kɑ yɛ̃ru kɑ nuku dobu wɛ̃. Adɑmɑ u rɑ dewɑ tɔn kɔ̃so u ɑrumɑni kɑsu u mɛnnɑ wi u wi, Gusunɔ wɛ̃ren sɔ̃. Yenin tii yɑ mɑɑ tubum sɛ̃. Yɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe wi u kĩ u woo kpɑrɑ.
Gɑ̃ɑnu bɑɑnire kɑ nin sɑɑwɑ
